name: senate_2026
note: The first round of the 2026 Senate election (9-10 October 2026; 27 of the 81 districts, a third of the country). Prepared, never run. A senator is elected by name in one district, so there is no list of options that holds everywhere; an option here is the party that nominated the candidate (the election office's `navrhující strana`), which is how the office itself adds the districts up. The options are the six parties whose candidates won more than 4% of the first round's valid votes over the 27 districts, and `Other` - which is large, 27%: independents, local movements, the smaller parties. A coalition's candidate counts for the one party that nominated them. The first round, because the second is a choice between two names. Reference results are the election office's (reference.csv, DECISIONS.md §47): `Česko` is the 27 districts together, although two thirds of the country did not vote; a region's row is the part of that region that voted, and a party is 0 there where it nominated no one - so by region the turnout can be read, the party shares say who stood.
